items.name: bbox-layout
items.title: bbox layout
items.description: Portable layout geometry for black-box design components. Pure module — no React, no canvas engine.

items.name: bbox-skin
items.title: bbox skin
items.description: Optional shape language for bbox-ui components: default / plain / sketch, selected with one inherited data-bbox-skin attribute. Ships the hand-drawn outline too — that part is real geometry, not CSS, so Block and Region import it.

items.name: port
items.title: Port
items.description: A port dot with its optional label and code field, over the frozen v1 lineage.

items.name: block
items.title: Block
items.description: A block body with its header, footer and sketch outline, over the frozen v1 lineage.

items.name: block-node-reactflow
items.title: Block node (React Flow adapter)
items.description: React Flow custom node wrapping the Block; ports emit <Handle> DOM elements painted with the shared port-dot classes. NOTE: currently imports @bbox-ui/core, which is not yet published to npm — install the `block` item and repoint the import until it is.

items.name: block-shape-tldraw
items.title: Block ShapeUtil (tldraw adapter)
items.description: tldraw ShapeUtil rendering the Block inside HTMLContainer; shape w/h are authoritative and port anchors are geometry points. NOTE: currently imports @bbox-ui/core, which is not yet published to npm — install the `block` item and repoint the import until it is.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small status/count pill. Reads its size from an ancestor Bar through BarSizeProvider, or takes its own size prop standalone.

items.name: bar
items.title: Bar
items.description: A horizontal strip with three slots (left / center / right) that casts its size down to Badge, EditableText, Glyph and Text through BarSizeProvider — no appearance cascade, size propagation only.

items.name: text
items.title: Text
items.description: Plain, non-editable text: a data-slot span plus a tone, for title/type labels and captions that aren't editable.

items.name: editable-text
items.title: Editable Text
items.description: Click-to-edit text control ported by value from packages/bbox-ui/src/textBox.tsx (docs/TEXTBOX-EDITING-SPEC.md) — the control never moves the surrounding text.

items.name: folding-chevron
items.title: Folding Chevron
items.description: A single Lucide ChevronRight built as a disclosure trigger, meant to pair with a Collapsible — install Collapsible from the stock shadcn registry (`npx shadcn add collapsible`); this item does not ship one.

items.name: block-card
items.title: Block (Simple View) — design trunk
items.description: The design-trunk Block (apps/storybook-basics): Container, Header band, BlockMembers, Glyph, Text slots, Chip. Supersedes the `block` item's packages/bbox-ui source as the current design — packages/bbox-ui stays published as-is until apps/docs migrates to this lineage (ARCHITECTURE.md, "Name the trunk").

items.name: port-dot
items.title: Port — design trunk
items.description: The design-trunk Port (apps/storybook-basics): the disc, surface ring, state ring, lit core and hit halo alone — no labels or slots (`labeled-port` adds those). Supersedes the `port` item's packages/bbox-ui source as the current design; packages/bbox-ui stays published as-is until apps/docs migrates (ARCHITECTURE.md, "Name the trunk").

items.name: code-editor
items.title: Code Editor
items.description: CodeMirror-backed code field ported by value from packages/bbox-ui's codeField, reconciling the write-policy engine with a since-diverged text-selection fix.

items.name: labeled-port
items.title: Labeled Port
items.description: Composite of Port plus its two independently positioned label slots, both absolutely positioned off the dot's own box.

items.name: port-edge
items.title: Port Edge
items.description: A rail of ports laid along one edge of a container, with lane reconciliation and grouping.

items.name: block-port
items.title: Ported Block
items.description: A Block with real PortEdge rails mounted on its walls — view/placement rules keep the rails tracking the block's own hug (docs/BLOCK-PORT-EDGES-PLAN.md §2).

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace
items.description: The paint for a two-ended shape whose path a host computes: direct, routed and elbow (orthogonal) curves, arrowheads, bends and terminals. Ported by value from packages/bbox-ui/src/trace.tsx, itself from SystemSketch's connectionPresentation.ts.

items.name: trace-badge
items.title: Trace Badge
items.description: A small editable label riding a Trace at its nearest-fraction point along the path.

items.name: trace-editor
items.title: Trace Editor
items.description: Trace wrapped with the one thing it deliberately never does itself: pointer-driven bend editing (docs/TRACE-CONTROL-POINTS-PLAN.md D4).

items.name: trace-tidy
items.title: Trace Tidy
items.description: The Tidy pass restated as a pure function over fixture data — ported verbatim from SystemSketch's src/blocks/connections/tidyEdges.ts. No DOM, no React; feed it measured obstacle rects.

items.name: wire-layer
items.title: Wire Layer
items.description: Paints a Wire[] as Traces between two Blocks' real, measured Port dots (docs/BLOCK-PORT-EDGES-PLAN.md §5).

items.name: menu-toolbar
items.title: Menu Toolbar
items.description: Roving-focus bar container over Base UI's Toolbar — the strip the floating pill, the tool dock, the chrome bar and the status strip all sit in. Consumes the trunk's ambient size cascade.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split Button
items.description: One primary action plus a chevron opening its alternates. Backs the tool dock's family cells and the draft bar's Merge control.

items.name: inline-rename
items.title: Inline Rename
items.description: A text field that commits on Enter or blur and reverts on Escape. Controlled only — the host owns the keybinding that starts a rename.

items.name: control-registry
items.title: Control Registry
items.description: Declare a value-bound control once, then compose it into many surfaces by recipe. A factory, so palettes and vocabularies are injected rather than imported.

items.name: control-strip
items.title: Control Strip
items.description: The one renderer for every registered control: trigger shape chosen by `trigger`, panel shape by `layout`, value preview by `glyph` family — all lookups, never per-kind conditionals.

items.name: floating-toolbar
items.title: Floating Toolbar
items.description: The positioned shell a control strip sits in, over FigJam's above/pinned/below placement policy. The host measures; the component never does.

items.name: tool-dock
items.title: Tool Dock
items.description: A bottom tool bar whose families are declared as data, each remembering its last-used member.

items.name: chrome-bar
items.title: Chrome Bar
items.description: Burger menu, back/forward, home and an eliding breadcrumb with a status dot — the editor's top-left identity strip.

items.name: branch-chip
items.title: Branch Chip
items.description: The branch or draft selector: current name, a count badge, and a popover of alternates with inline rename.

items.name: panel-shell
items.title: Panel Shell
items.description: The side-panel frame — eyebrow, title, close, scrollable body. The shell is the component; each panel is one instance of it.

items.name: frames-panel
items.title: Frames Panel
items.description: Reorderable board-navigation rows with host-rendered previews, plus a save-this-view row.

items.name: problems-panel
items.title: Problems Panel
items.description: A diagnostics list in VS Code's shape: severity counts, a severity filter, grouped rows carrying a rule code. Severities are config, not a hardcoded three.

items.name: status-strip
items.title: Status Strip
items.description: The corner cluster of panel launchers with badges and a zoom readout.

items.name: history-list
items.title: History List
items.description: A version rail where selecting an entry sets it as the BEFORE side of a comparison.

items.name: property-table
items.title: Property Table
items.description: Per-element and flat-table views of a property diff, with optional Figma-style word-level highlighting.

items.name: code-view
items.title: Code View
items.description: A line-diff view of two text versions.

items.name: compare-review
items.title: Compare Review
items.description: The whole diff-review surface — history rail, two version panes, a properties/code rail, and side-by-side or overlay. Headless: the host supplies the modal and both renderers.

items.name: draft-bar
items.title: Draft Bar
items.description: The draft-mode strip: exit, draft name, and a change-gated compare/merge pair.
